create_SE3_random_group: create random SE3 group elements using rand or randn with configurable size and device
create_SE3_identity: create an identity SE3 group tensor with optional batch dimensions and gradient support
compute_SE3_exp_map: compute the exponential map from a 6D tangent vector to an SE3 group element
compute_SE3_log_map: compute the logarithm map from an SE3 group element to a 6D tangent vector
transform_points_SE3: transform 3D points by an SE3 group element using transform or untransform operations
